title: Euler Immersion
summary: We address the Euler immersion problem, a fluid-structure interaction problem in which an elastic body is immersed in an incompressible inviscid fluid governed by the Euler equations. We show that the system exhibits a loss of one derivative and formulate the problem in analytic function spaces. We then prove local well-posedness in analytic spaces under velocity-matching boundary conditions. Finally, by means of an example, we show that existence fails in analytic spaces when both velocity and stress-matching boundary conditions are prescribed.
